checks.name: PDD10 (%)
checks.note: Beyer GP, JACMP 14(1):4077, 2013: three TrueBeam linacs, 10 x 10 cm2, SSD 100 cm, PDD10 66.1-66.2 %; Chang et al. 2019 (PMC6370991) representative beam data within 1 %; informative here: the kernel is the head-less Mohan spectrum, as the Monte Carlo references; pb_vs_mc grades the depth dose against them (MC PDD10 68.0 %)

checks.name: d_max (mm)
checks.note: Beyer 2013: d_max about 1.41 cm for a measured 6 MV 10 x 10 field. The CCC engine transports photons only: without contamination electrons the build-up is longer (a pure-photon 6 MV beam peaks at 17-20 mm), and the harness reads d_max on a 2.5-5 mm grid, so the research target is 12-25 mm.

checks.name: PDD20/PDD10
checks.note: typical flattened 6 MV: PDD20/PDD10 about 0.58 (TPR20,10 about 0.67); informative

checks.name: flatness (%)
checks.note: MPPG 5.a Table 5 / TG-142: profile flatness within 3 % over the central 80 % of the field at 10 cm depth

checks.name: penumbra 80–20 % (mm)
checks.note: Beyer 2013: 7.0 mm (80-20 %) at 10 cm depth for 10 x 10 on TrueBeam; informative because the beamlet grid (5 mm) and the kernels broaden the computed penumbra
